metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi Plugin Shelf for REAPER\par A visual plugin browser: your plugins and FX chains as thumbnails on a shelf, sorted into your own categories.\par \par - Tiles show the plugin's own window (screen capture), so you find plugins by how they look\par - FX chains as tiles, with mini thumbnails of every plugin inside\par - Search by bits of words in any order ("comp air" finds AIR Compressor)\par - Quick Switch: hold Left Alt and type a category number, 0 + Enter = Home\par - Right-click a tile > Presets: insert the plugin with a preset loaded\par - Override script: REAPER's FX button opens Plugin Shelf instead of the stock window\par \par Runs as a free DEMO with no time limit. A license key unlocks the full version.\par Requires ReaImGui (ReaPack). REAPER 7. For REAPER 6 use the Lua 5.3 package from the shop.\par Icons: also install "Emelowsky - Plugin Shelf for REAPER (icon pack)" from this repository (4000+ plugin icons, downloaded once).\par Manuals and toolbar icon: in the shop download (Shop link). }

version.author: Emelowsky
version.changelog: v3.7.7 Quick Switch window: the title is just "Quick Switch" (no shortcut in brackets).

metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi Icon pack for Plugin Shelf for REAPER\par 4125 ready-made plugin icons. They install next to the script, and Plugin Shelf picks them up by plugin name (Automatic categories wizard, or its "Fill in icons" button for tiles you already have).\par Install it once - script updates do not download the icons again. }
